ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing electronics than a smart display right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: JSAUX USB-C to USB A Cable 3.1A Fast Charging [2-Pack 6.6ft], USB Type C Charger Cord Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S10 S9 S8 S20 Plus A51 A12 A11, Note 10 9 8, PS5 Controller USB C Charger-Green; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Spare cables are useful, but my recent purchases do not establish a need for USB-C connections.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a clear use for a voice-controlled speaker.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My car purchases have focused on mounts and connections; adding Alexa does not address an obvious need.
ItemID: 5; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A small smart display is less useful to me right now than camera or storage accessories.
ItemID: 6; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera accessory purchases do not imply that I need a home monitoring camera.
ItemID: 7; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my television; the 4K capability is not the main draw for my 720p set.
ItemID: 8; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I regularly buy memory cards and recently bought a reader, so I would consider this for extra storage after checking device compatibility.
ItemID: 9; Title: Corsair Vengeance LPX 128GB (4x32GB) DDR4 3200(PC4-28800) C18 1.35V Desktop Memory - Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current desktop upgrade need, and this RAM does not serve the same purpose as my removable memory cards.
ItemID: 10; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power strip purchases suggest a need for outlets, but I have no clear need for Alexa-controlled power.
